Macro Meal Planner

Build meals from a 42-food nutrition database to hit your protein, carb and fat targets.

Nutrition values are typical per-100g estimates. For information only — not medical advice.

📖 How to use

  1. Set your daily protein, carbs, and fat targets in grams.
  2. Use the search box to narrow the food list, then add foods with their weight in grams.
  3. Add as many food rows as your meal needs.
  4. Watch the totals and progress bars track against your targets.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Where do the nutrition values come from?

Typical per-100g values in line with USDA data. Brands and cooking methods vary, so treat them as close estimates.

How are calories computed?

Protein and carbs count 4 kcal per gram, fat counts 9 kcal per gram (Atwater factors).

Is my meal saved?

Yes, in your browser's localStorage, so your plan is still there when you return. Nothing leaves your device.
